recommendations.recommendation: Derive evidence confidence at ingestion instead of defaulting it
recommendations.why: Confidence is an input to every reasoning step downstream. A constant carries no information, so it cannot separate strong evidence from weak, and every confidence-weighted figure in the system is effectively unweighted.
recommendations.finding: Evidence confidence is asserted, not derived

components.basis: a banded group-by over every evidence row
the count is exact; the consequence weighting attached to this kind of absence is a stated modelling judgement, not a measurement
1,499 rows were examined to establish this

benefit.label: Estimated
benefit.statement: Closing this would bring 100.0% of the affected population back into scope: all 1,499 evidence rows share one band.
benefit.unit: share of the affected population that is usable
benefit.why: Estimated: both endpoints are measured from the records — the current share and the complete one. What is estimated is that the fix reaches all of the affected rows rather than some of them.

effort.basis: This needs a change in what the source system records or in how people work, and neither is sizeable from row counts. No estimate is offered rather than a guessed one.

recommendations.nextAction: Evidence confidence varies with source reliability and freshness at the point of ingestion.

recommendations.recommendation: Register the detected risks the organization accepts as real, with an owner each
recommendations.why: A derived risk is a finding. Until it is registered it cannot be assigned, tracked, or closed, and nothing distinguishes a risk somebody decided to accept from one nobody has seen.
recommendations.finding: 1 detected risks, none registered or owned

components.basis: a row count over the risk register
the count is exact; the consequence weighting attached to this kind of absence is a stated modelling judgement, not a measurement
structural finding — an absent table has no population to measure over

benefit.label: Projected
benefit.statement: Detected risks become ownable, trackable and closable, and an accepted risk becomes distinguishable from an unseen one.
benefit.why: Projected: the benefit is that a class of conclusion becomes possible. There is no current value to express an improvement against, and inventing one would be a fabrication.

effort.basis: This needs a change in what the source system records or in how people work, and neither is sizeable from row counts. No estimate is offered rather than a guessed one.

recommendations.esoNote: No executable object definitions exist for this organization, so this cannot yet be bound to something runnable. The execution type it needs is stated instead.
recommendations.nextAction: The risks the organization accepts as real exist as rows in hpbrain_risks with an owner and a mitigation.

recommendations.recommendation: Populate the observation date on evidence from the source record
recommendations.why: Evidence freshness decays on a 90-day half-life, and freshness weights every corroboration. Undated evidence has to be weighted by its ingestion date instead, which overstates how current it is when a historical file is loaded.
recommendations.finding: 1499 of 1499 evidence rows carry no observation date

evidence.what: evidence rows with no observation date

method.priority: priorityScore = (severity / 5) x confidence x tractability. Severity and confidence are inherited from the finding; tractability is fixed per finding kind, so the ordering cannot be tuned per item.
method.benefit: Labelled Observed, Estimated, Projected or Unknown. Estimated benefits ship both endpoints. No monetary benefit is produced anywhere, because this organization has recorded no cost, revenue or penalty data — a currency figure could only be invented.
method.binding: Each recommendation names the execution type it needs (Assessment, Learning, Workflow or Communication). Binding to a specific executable object requires definitions in hpbrain_eso_definitions, and this organization has none.
method.noLlm: Every figure, ranking and category here is computed from the organization's records. No language model contributed to any of them.

derivation.method: Every figure is computed deterministically by SQL aggregation over this organization's own rows, on read.
derivation.llm: No language model contributed to any figure, ranking, category or conclusion in this response.
derivation.scope: Every query is filtered to tenant_id = 8. No aggregate crosses organizations.
derivation.liveness: Cached against a fingerprint of the source data rather than a clock, so a change to the organization's records invalidates it immediately.
